ai_summary: Aequs Limited reported robust Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue growth of 55% year-on-year, driven by a 40% expansion in aerospace and a near-tripling of its consumer segment. While reported EBITDA was affected by reduced other income, operational EBITDA surged 3.5x sequentially, fueled by a 24% narrowing of consumer losses which puts the company on track for Q4 FY27 segment breakeven. Major aerospace wins, including a 15-year "Make in India" A320 wheel contract with Safran, boosted the order book past USD 1 billion, though the company continues to report a net loss as it scales up operations and capacity.
